about: Plain sentences a real person might type into the Wisdom Finder, each with the topic ids that would be a right answer (any one of them counts). Written before the matcher was tuned. The holdout set was written at the same time and not looked at while the curated phrases were written; the test reports both. holdout2 (second build), holdout3 (third build), holdout4 (fourth build) and holdout5 (sixth build) were each written and committed before matching.json was touched; holdout2 and holdout3 have since been tuned for, and holdout4's two misses were tuned for in the sixth build. holdout6 (seventh build, 25 sentences across the topics written in full) was written and committed before matching.json was touched for that build; its nine misses were the tuning set of the eighth build. holdout7 (eighth build, 30 sentences, each aimed at a different topic written in full, sixteen of them at topics written in the sixth and seventh builds) was written and committed before matching.json or the matcher was touched, and was the clean set of that build. Read by client/src/lib/wisdom-match.test.ts. holdout8 (ninth build, 24 sentences written by the coordinator, who had not seen the phrasings, each set to the topic written in full that its description names; a twenty-fifth, about a church split and distrust of pastors, was dropped because Church Hurt is not yet written in full) was committed before the matcher or matching.json was touched, and is the clean set; it is never tuned to.
